content: Temporal: append-only server-side Event History records decisions/activity results/timers/signals. Workers are stateless (any worker can pick up any task); on each workflow task the worker replays the full Event History deterministically then executes new code. Task Queues decouple server from workers via long-poll pull. Requires a separate Temporal cluster plus deterministic workflow-code constraints - the opposite of entflow's every-effect-explicit-typed-step model.
